text_block_list.text:
On the day of the race, Голд Шип
prepares to
spread her wings and show
off her legendary
butterfly stroke. Too
bad the Hopeful Stakes
takes place on
land!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Even so, the Pacific Ocean is waiting for
her. Fly
toward the finish line with
enough momentum to
clear an ocean
trench, Голд Шип!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
